rows.note: Use 大道 as the all-purpose term for a broad avenue or major named road.

example.english: This tree-lined avenue is very pleasant to walk along.
example.traditional: 呢條大道兩旁種滿樹，行落去好舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 daai6 dou6 loeng5 pong4 zung3 mun5 syu6 haang4 lok6 heoi3 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use 方法 as the all-purpose term for a method or means of accomplishing something.

example.english: I still haven't found an avenue for solving this problem.
example.traditional: 我仲未搵到解決呢個問題嘅方法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 wan2 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use 途徑 for a particular channel, route, or approach to achieving something rather than a general method.

example.english: This program has provided young people with an avenue for further education.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃為年輕人提供咗一條升學途徑。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wai4 nin4 hing1 jan4 tai4 gung1 zo2 jat1 tiu4 sing1 hok6 tou4 ging3
